verdict.rationale: Glama's Gateway routes agent MCP calls through a policy layer where 'you decide what it's allowed to do'. Calls are described as 'access-controlled, and credential-managed', and hosting offers per-tool enable/disable, all of which support least-privilege for agents. None of the evidence shows issuing distinct scoped API keys or tokens per agent: access control appears to be configured per server or tool, not per credential. Missing for 10: documented issuance of per-agent scoped API credentials, scope/permission definitions on keys, expiry/revocation controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
